findings.condition: If the PR head changes after CURRENT_HEAD is fetched but before the marker comment is created or updated, the older run passes the equality check and can publish a PASSED review for the previous commit onto the updated PR. The stale marker can persist if the replacement run later fails before publication.
findings.evidence: Exact-head validation is a separate gh api read followed later by an unconditional comment upsert; there is no post-publication recheck, conditional write, or per-PR serialization. test_workflow_roles.py covers a head that is already stale before the read, but not an update between the read and write.

findings.condition: When maintainers use docs/architecture.md as the architecture inventory, it remains stale after the operational review pipeline changes from the legacy matrix to routed specialists and conditional adjudication.
findings.evidence: The unchanged synchronization rule in this file requires architecture or convention changes to update both CLAUDE.md and docs/architecture.md in the same change. This diff adds and activates the specialist-review architecture but does not include docs/architecture.md.

findings.condition: When run-panel.sh is invoked without ROLE_REVIEW=1 for a retained regression or manual legacy run, it now selects different Kiro and Codex models from the preserved legacy path, which can change availability, behavior, and cost or make a fixture fail independently of the specialist activation.
findings.evidence: The active specialist branch execs before the legacy roster, so changing gpt-5.6-terra to gpt-5.6-sol and adding an explicit Codex Astra model affects only the ROLE_REVIEW-disabled branch. ADR-002 scopes the alias migration to the active path and states that existing provider bindings remain.

uncertainties: [REDACTED], native execution must verify that fetching private HEAD Git objects authenticates explicitly rather than relying on the removed checkout credential helper.

The supplied tests use fake CLIs and do not establish that every configured specialist and chair model is available to the self-hosted runner; ADR-002 correctly requires separate native execution evidence.
The supplied diff does not show the existing specialist test workflow, so this review could not verify that CI actually discovers and executes all three newly added test modules.

The fixed /tmp/pr-review workspace is safe only if runner jobs sharing a host are serialized and prior child processes cannot survive cancellation; no runner topology or process-reaping evidence was supplied.
